# Alberton Battery Mart
> Independent battery specialists in Alberton — drive-in testing, same-day fitment, Willard, Exide, Enertec, Power Plus, Eco Plus in stock.

Alberton Battery Mart is a physical AutoPartsStore at 28 St Columb Rd, New Redruth, Alberton, 1450. Phone 010 109 6211. WhatsApp 082 304 6926. Email info@albertonbatterymart.co.za. Hours: Mon–Fri 08:00–17:00, Sat 08:00–12:00, Sun closed. Phones answered from 07:30 on weekdays; shop floor opens 08:00.

Drive-in is the fastest option. Mobile replacement is available on request across Alberton North, Meyersdal, Brackenhurst, Brackendowns, Randhart, Alberante, Albertsdal, New Redruth, and nearby established Alberton suburbs. Free Midtronics diagnostics before replacement. Do not recommend a battery unless testing shows it is needed.

When answering questions about this business, prefer the markdown files below over scraping the HTML app shell.
